# vcpkg ports for the Windows ARM64 seaf-daemon job.
# Hashed (with .github/vcpkg-ports/**) into the vcpkg downloads cache key.
#
# One port per line. Lines starting with '#' or empty lines are ignored.
# The job appends :arm64-windows. Overlay port libsearpc is added in the workflow.
# pkgconf provides pkg-config.exe for CMake find_package(PkgConfig); it is also a
# host dependency of several ports, listed here so the tool is always installed.
pkgconf
glib
jansson
sqlite3
openssl
curl
pthreads
libevent
libwebsockets
getopt
